baseline.cachePolicy: Fresh browser context for each cold cycle; warm cycle reuses the same context. HTTP caching disabled by routing; source/network bytes are fixed local mirrors. The browser process is restarted per cold/warm pair; OS filesystem cache is not flushed.

candidate.cachePolicy: Fresh browser context for each cold cycle; warm cycle reuses the same context. HTTP caching disabled by routing; source/network bytes are fixed local mirrors. The browser process is restarted per cold/warm pair; OS filesystem cache is not flushed.

provenance.note: Baseline uses the published Code Views 0.26.5; candidate uses an unpublished 0.26.7 tarball. Candidate lock integrity is provisional until the registry release is verified; localOverlay and build-info notices identify the measured bytes. Runtime source hashes below identify the measured optimization.
